reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD has its own workbench tool bars and enables tools from its BarCtx state; there is no Matrix Top 11 catalogue.
Selection is QymCAD document-model state, not an OM9 ObjectId set with document stamps.
The curve edits are sketch-entity operations tied to QymCAD's Project/Id model.

rationale: QymCAD has sketch/part mirror and transform tool state, but no Matrix Top 11 command adapter over the OM9 document. The placement/reflection math is additive safe Rust.
not_reused: QymCAD BarCtx/Hand UI state and its sketch Id document model.
QymCAD native/OCCT adapters; the Top 11 are host command adapters over OM9's document.
l3_scope: Move and Rotate collect points through accept_world_point and commit placement transforms. Mirror supports Copy or Delete-Input and switches between the two-point vertical plane and a three-point arbitrary plane by typing 3Point while its prompt runs (or by the Mirror 3Point command). It bakes rigid or non-rigid placements: affine circles become NURBS ellipses, mesh/cloud normals and winding are transformed, and BRep bodies mirror through OCCT.
